items.concept: Covering maps are locally a stack of homeomorphic sheets.
items.inspection_target: Each sheet is an open interval mapped homeomorphically onto the same arc.
items.representation: Small base arc in S^1 with lifted intervals in R.
items.validation: Lifted intervals are disjoint and have equal local-coordinate width.

items.concept: A surjective local homeomorphism can fail the covering condition.
items.inspection_target: Endpoint components cover only half of the selected base neighborhood.
items.representation: Restricted exponential map (0,2) -> S^1 near the point 1.
items.validation: Exactly two preimage components are incomplete over the chosen arc.

items.concept: The lifting criterion becomes subgroup containment for circle maps.
items.inspection_target: Rows light up exactly at multiples of n.
items.representation: Divisibility heat map for degrees m through n-sheet covers.
items.validation: Boolean lift result equals m % n == 0 for every table entry.

items.concept: Monodromy is the action of pi_1 of the base on a fiber.
items.inspection_target: The generator advances each sheet by one step.
items.representation: Directed cyclic permutation of a finite fiber.
items.validation: The action graph has one orbit and generator order n.

items.concept: The chapter proof chain builds global algebra from local lifting.
items.inspection_target: Lifting facts feed monodromy; monodromy feeds classification and universality.
items.representation: Directed dependency graph of definitions and theorems.

items.concept: A universal cover is a simply connected space over the base.
items.inspection_target: All marked fiber points differ by integer translations.
items.representation: Integer lattice copies of a torus chart in R^2.
items.validation: Modulo-Z^2 projection residual is zero within tolerance.
